summary: This short note describes the Monastery of the Visitation in Georgetown, a monastery belonging to the Visitation Order. It is located in the District of Columbia, United States. The note contains only this basic identification and no further details.
one_line: The Monastery of the Visitation in Georgetown is a Visitation Order monastery in Washington, D.C.
